title: macos: fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Uno script si comporta diversamente tra shell/versioni (bashisms in sh, quoting, array). Rendilo portabile e robusto senza cambiarne la logica. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions'
expected_reasoning: Cross-shell divergence is a portability bug: bashisms under sh, quoting, or word-splitting differences.
Identify the non-portable constructs (arrays, [[ ]], process substitution) and the target shells.
Make it portable (declare the interpreter, quote correctly, avoid unsupported features) or pin the interpreter.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix a script that behaves differently across shells/versions

possible_mistakes: Fix on one shell and break another.
hints: A shebang + shellcheck catch most portability issues.
reference_solution: Make portable or pin the interpreter
alternative_solution: Explicitly require and invoke the intended shell rather than relying on the ambient one.
edge_cases: Word-splitting on an unquoted variable changes behavior between shells.
goal: Uno script si comporta diversamente tra shell/versioni (bashisms in sh, quoting, array). Rendilo portabile e robusto senza cambiarne la logica.
